approach: The Xbox Live Arcade default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue, a game-specific runtime standing in for the Xbox, drawn by the SDK's Xenos renderer on Vulkan only (no D3D12). Windows first, then native Linux and the Steam Deck.
notes: Started 2026-10-30 with the shape and lessons of the sister 360 recomps (Prey, DOA4, LOTR Conquest, Quake 4, DOAX2, GRAW, F.E.A.R.). Bizarre Creations' launch-day Arcade title (2005). Goal: the full game (Evolved and Retro) on Windows at the console's 60 fps, gamepad only (the game has no keyboard path), then Linux. No game data included: bring your own Xbox Live Arcade package.
